notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK candidate for callback-time stability of a conveyed region designator during timestamped attribute reflection. The scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It asserts only that the receiver can query the callback-visible designator and observes the sent-time range after the publisher changes its source region. It does not claim provider conformance, timestamp ordering, retraction semantics, or broader DDM behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional attribute update and region query services with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection callback
